definitions: Mark (a gauge or instrument) with a standard scale of readings.
Correlate the readings of (an instrument) with those of a standard in order to check the instrument's accuracy.
Adjust (experimental results) to take account of extraneous factors.
examples: The thermometer was calibrated against a known standard.
You need to calibrate your monitor for accurate colour reproduction.
We need to calibrate our expectations.
The model was calibrated using historical data.
